onboarding.welcome.title: Welcome to MarkMySteps
onboarding.welcome.body: Follow your route, plan your trip and look back on it later. Everything stays yours.
onboarding.name.title: What’s your name?
onboarding.name.body: Without a server there’s no account and no password. Your name only appears on your own trips, and stays on this device.
onboarding.globe.title: Your trips on the map
onboarding.globe.body: All your trips as colourful routes on a 3D globe, with a dot for every stop. Tap a trip to open it with your timeline and photos.
onboarding.plan.title: Plan your route
onboarding.plan.body: Build your route with stops, nights and transport: car, train, boat, or a flight with layovers. The distances and your days add up by themselves.
onboarding.trips.title: Look back on your trips
onboarding.trips.body: Every trip keeps its map, its days and its numbers. Your photos land on the right day and in the right place all by themselves.
onboarding.share.title: Share with the folks at home
onboarding.share.body: One private link with your map, your days and your photos. Read only, and nobody needs to create an account.
onboarding.offline.title: Battery-friendly & offline
onboarding.offline.body: Tracking goes easy on your battery and works without internet: everything is buffered and uploaded later.
onboarding.theme.title: Light or dark?
onboarding.theme.body: Pick your theme. You can always change it later in Settings.
onboarding.airports.title: Your usual airports
onboarding.airports.body: Which airports do you usually fly from? You can change this later in <path>Settings › Preferences</path>.
onboarding.perm.denied: Denied. You can turn this on later in Settings.
onboarding.location.title: Location permission
onboarding.location.body: To track your route, the app asks for your location. A GPS point is only saved when you move, which saves your battery.
onboarding.always.title: Allow location all the time
onboarding.always.body: Tracking with the screen off only works when location is set to “{always}”. Ask for it here; if your phone sends you to the settings, follow this path:
onboarding.always.path: Apps › MarkMySteps › Permissions › Location › Allow all the time
onboarding.gallery.title: Your photos
onboarding.gallery.body: Without a server, your photos come from your device’s gallery. They stay where they are: the app only reads them, and nothing leaves your phone. Android only shares the location in a photo with a separate permission; without that second one they won’t appear on the map.
onboarding.gallery.noLocation: Photo location denied. Your photos won’t appear on the map.
onboarding.notifs.title: Notifications
onboarding.notifs.body: Only what you need to know: the status of your tracking and updates from your travel companions. No ads, no tips, no reminders to open the app. You can always change this in your device settings.
onboarding.notifs.denied: Denied. Without a notification, tracking can’t run in the background.
onboarding.start.title: Start your first trip
onboarding.start.body: Fill in a name and your dates, and add your stops. The rest fills itself in while you travel: your route, your photos and your days.
